BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Becker, Hasegawa, Randall, Rivers, Dhingra, Schoesler, Short, Padden, Conway, Wilson, L., Liias, and Van De Wege

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to submitting reports to the legislature; and adding a new section to chapter 43.01 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 43.01 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Whenever an agency is required to submit a report to the legislature in November or December, the agency shall make all practicable efforts to submit the report by October 31st.
